headline: Recommended City Council approve three Golf and Tennis Commission reappointments, all by 3-0 votes.
summary: The Public Services Committee reviewed three reappointments to the Beverly Golf and Tennis Commission and voted to recommend Council approval for each. An item on Committee priorities was held for later discussion.
decisions: Recommended the Council approve the reappointment of Chad Crandell, 59 Lothrop Street, to the Beverly Golf and Tennis Commission (3-0).
Recommended the Council approve the reappointment of Kevin Ascolillo, 4 Sherwood Lane, to the Beverly Golf and Tennis Commission (3-0).
Recommended the Council approve the reappointment of Arthur Athanas, 77 Hale Street, to the Beverly Golf and Tennis Commission (3-0).
